data.name: Golshanun
data.gender_notes: Golshanun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Persian word 'golshan' meaning garden. The suffix 'un' means 'of roses'. This name evokes images of a beautiful garden filled with roses, symbolizing love, passion, and beauty. The name Golshanun carries the meaning “Garden of Roses” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Golshanun usually hope their child will grow to embody garden of roses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition, representing the garden of paradise. The beauty and fragrance of roses in this name remind us of the blessings and rewards that await us in the hereafter.
data.etymology: Golshanun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garden of Roses.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Golshanun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
